The *Uttarātherīgāthā* (Thig 7.1) is a verse text belonging to the *Therīgāthā* in the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. The collection records poems associated with enlightened elder nuns (*therīs*), and this text is cataloged under the name of the nun Uttarā [SuttaCentral]. On SuttaCentral, it is listed with twelve translations across nine modern languages, including English versions by Ayya Soma and Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral]. The secondary literature excerpts retrieved in the dossier do not discuss this text, instead containing homonymous matches for the name Uttara or related terms.

Regarding parallels and text reuse, SuttaCentral lists no cross-language parallels, and DharmaNexus finds no cross-language matches with a score of 10 or higher [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. Within the Pali canon and commentary, DharmaNexus detects nineteen text-reuse matches across three texts [DharmaNexus]. The primary reuse partner is the commentary, the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, which contains fifteen matches covering virtually the entire poem (segments §0.3–7.4 aligned with commentary segments §2629–2648 at a similarity of 0.93) [DharmaNexus].
